views.name: classified_tracks
views.body_sql:
SELECT 
    TrackId AS track,
    Milliseconds / 60000.0 AS duration_minutes,
    CASE 
        WHEN Milliseconds / 60000.0 < 3 THEN 'Short'
        WHEN Milliseconds / 60000.0 <= 5 THEN 'Medium'
        ELSE 'Long'
    END AS category
FROM Track
views.description: joins track records with global duration thresholds, converts duration to minutes, and applies the classification rule to assign a category.

views.name: category_aggregates
views.body_sql:
SELECT 
    ct.category,
    MIN(ct.duration_minutes) AS min_duration_minutes,
    MAX(ct.duration_minutes) AS max_duration_minutes,
    SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity) AS total_revenue
FROM classified_tracks ct
JOIN InvoiceLine il ON ct.track = il.TrackId
GROUP BY ct.category
views.description: groups the classified tracks by category to compute minimum duration, maximum duration, and total revenue.
